package network
config interface 'lan'
	option device 'br-lan'
	option proto 'dhcp'
package dhcp
config dhcp 'lan'
	option interface 'lan'
	option ignore '1'
package wireless
config wifi-iface 'w'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'ap'
	option network 'lan'
	option ssid 'Office'
	option encryption 'psk2'
